name: Wildflower Honey
promptName: Hexagonal Glass Honey Jar with Wood Lid
legacyNames: Hexagonal Glass Honey Jar with Wood Lid
description: A hexagonal faceted glass jar filled with thick raw amber honey and sealed with a turned solid wood lid.
materials: faceted hexagonal glass jar with clear, flat-sided walls; turned solid wood lid with a smooth domed profile; thick raw honey filling
primaryColors: amber gold (honey), natural wood tan (lid), clear glass
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, label, sticker, engraving, or emblem on the glass or the wood lid; keep both surfaces entirely blank and unmarked at every angle. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the same hexagonal facet count and jar proportions, the same amber honey color and viscosity, and the same turned wood lid shape and grain tone consistent across all four angles.
